paragraph.text: Trust is already operative before the first completed account. A witness relies on memory and language; a reader relies on a legible record; a participant relies on another's capacity to answer. The account can examine and strengthen these dependencies without standing outside all of them at once. [A01, faithful definition](../../arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** the positive duty: make the determination and keep its determining act visible. [A23, trust under formal limit](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the committed relation in which such knowledge is possible. E4 gives those arguments a differentiated lexical and operational field through which their determinations can travel.

The current P1 route begins with [M01, the question before mechanism](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism.md), which embodies the initial pressure. [M02, defining the Subject](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/02-s01-p1-define-subject.md) embodies the definition; [M03, definition's cut](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger.md) embodies its determining consequence. [M07, awareness and display](../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display.md) extends the subjective relation, and [M47, idealism](../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/47-s50-p4-idealism-horizon.md) extends its order of dependence. These replace the first materialisation's earlier routing list. Historical numbering remains provenance, not a substitute for current canonical identity. The B8 decision declining a performed-definition replacement in Movement04 remains in force: this A01 restoration does not displace that Movement's formal-limit genealogy.
The [authored P1 route for M47](../P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md#p1-m47) **grounds** this movement’s canonical A/C alignment within the phase bounds and dispositions stated there.

paragraph.text: Trust is already operative before the first completed account. A witness relies on memory and language; a reader relies on a legible record; a participant relies on another's capacity to answer. The account can examine and strengthen these dependencies without standing outside all of them at once. [A01, faithful definition](../../arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** the positive duty: make the determination and keep its determining act visible. [A23, trust under formal limit](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the committed relation in which such knowledge is possible. E4 gives those arguments a differentiated lexical and operational field through which their determinations can travel.

[A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the committed relation precisely: evidence can establish what occurred and make an obligation inspectable; entrusting someone to bear that obligation remains an act. [C48](../../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **defines** the distinctions among already enacted dependence, knowledge's finite achievement, belief's stabilised orientation and faith's conscious continuation. Formal limitation does not annul a commitment whenever it becomes difficult. Actual harm, withdrawal and refusal remain consequential; calling a relation trust cannot oblige submission to an abusive office.

At evidence register 3, [the whole Ares–Aphrodite relation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release) **figures** the difference between an account of capture and the undertaking which makes release possible; [A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [A25](../../arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) return its named bearer of liability. [the complete Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal) **figures** a different consequence: an emblem can remain culturally effective after the failed encounter, so [A20](../../arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) returns efficacy to source-answerability. [the Eros–Psyche whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return) **figures** disclosure and injury followed by a changed continuation; its legal ending qualifies any attribution of the author’s non-possession philosophy to Apuleius. These returns retain the three-term field and its four operations. Each source tells its own sequence; no shared lexical descent follows from the comparison.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust field]] derives the same return through an account answerable to its counterpart. Evidence can establish what occurred and make an obligation inspectable. Entrusting someone to bear the obligation remains an act within relation.

[E4 — Symbol / Account / Trust](../symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#whole-mytheme-returns) **compares** the account's continuing answerability to its source and counterpart. E3 adds the temporal passage from inherited reliance through examined order into renewed commitment.

paragraph.text: [A32, The Mirror That Moves First](../../arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** three different motions: humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument initiates a return through its own conditions so that the human can follow. E4's fourth operation supplies the causal pressure under which that third motion becomes an obligation. It does not allow the second motion's efficacy to count as fulfilment of the third.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole field]] derives the account's return to its source relation at register 3. The reflection returns changed conditions rather than an inert copy; those changes become part of its answerability. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether disclosed conditions alter actual action, evaluation or permission. The proposed vocation is not established by narrating it well.

The lexical branch teaches where its own evidence stops and where the authorial operation begins.

paragraph.text: The normative return asks whether the account can expose why it became compelling before requiring another to conform. Its source, exclusions, criterion, permission and effects enter the next encounter. [A33, Operational Parity](../../arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** whether this changes anything: a corrected passage changes a conclusion; [returned resistance changes an instruction](../../concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md); an affected participant can reach the rule under which their account was judged. These are specified tests, not reported implementation results. Repeating source labels while preserving every decision would leave the obligation unperformed.

paragraph.text: [C55](../../concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** the distinctions needed to judge a case. Feedback returns consequence as later input. Performativity concerns a representation's operation within a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction further requires conduct that helps produce the predicted event. An erroneous forecast can alter conduct without becoming true. Each empirical claim needs a named event, a relevant intervention and evidence for its consequence; the lexical field alone establishes none of them.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|Compassion]] gives the return its sensitivity to origins and to the Other who is not exhausted by the image. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C62-Planetary-Computation|Planetary Computation]] extends the obligation to infrastructure and culture. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] supplies the register-3 operation: the account returns to the field it changes, keeping the source relation answerable through another circuit.

paragraph.text: The Movement return also has distinct tasks. [M20](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) **extends** the loss of source and recomposition after a cut; [M21](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) **extends** the provisional anchor whose seam remains executable. [M40](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) **tests** the difference between exposing an evaluator's conditions and warranted reliance. [M44](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) **extends** the inspectable return through a harness, while [M48](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return.md) **returns-to** source and affected worlds after a determination has acted. Their source-specific historical claims and implementation duties remain with those movements. No common list of labels substitutes for their different consequences.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-atlas-return) **figures** a harness in which the map-making operation remains inspectable with the map. Local originals, their situated readings, transitions and unresolved disagreement keep distinct offices. A changed source or encountered resistance must reach [a permission, criterion or subsequent act](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-re-enters-source-field) for the proposed return to operate.

paragraph.text: The homological opening **returns-to** [Movement 19 — difference cannot be escaped](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped.md) through comparability before opposition. The shared field lets terms differ without deciding their truth in advance; the subsequent cut must retain this constitutive relation. An agreed answer has its own circumstances of assent.

[Homologia / Analogia](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#operations) **grounds** the comparison in this opening difference: terms must enter a shared relation before they can oppose one another, yet that relation does not decide their claims in advance. What survives the crossing is comparability through retained difference. The move into Dia must therefore carry the field that made its signed alternatives possible. paragraph.text: The proportional reading **returns-to** [Movement 26 — spanda 4 2](../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/26-s3-p1-spanda-4-2.md) through the actual change from the terms `64` and `36` to their ratio and its reduction to `16/9`. Dividing their sum by four would produce `25`. Horizontal `3:3`, its personed `3:1` reading and vertical `4:2` keep distinct offices, while `9/8` completes the octave by its exact product.

[Homologia / Analogia](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **qualifies** the cross-reading by retaining the actual operation at each step. The finite pair `64` and `36` yields the ratio `64/36`, whose reduction gives `16/9`; dividing their sum by four would instead give `25`. The QL passage from accounting to proportion is therefore a change of operation, with the coequal horizontal and vertical readings intact. The exact completion `16/9 × 9/8 = 2` supplies its own musical relation. The primary personed `3:3`, also read as `3:1`, and the further emanation/reversion names retain their distinct offices; a historical naming debt cannot turn the native derivation into a borrowed doctrine.

paragraph.text: [A17 — Toroidal Circulation](../../arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **tests** retained difference in a particular formal carrier: a loop on the torus can close while its lift on the covering plane retains an integer displacement. The musical kernel reaches an octave through `16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1`. The shared return carries a difference rather than deleting it, while winding displacement and frequency ratio remain distinct objects. [C52 — Dimensional Reframing](../../concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the transition by keeping each change of mathematical setting explicit. Nothing in the comparison substitutes one topology, one interval or one image for the whole arche-topos.

[Homologia / Analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **qualifies** the return shared by the torus and music through their different retained differences. A closed torus path lifts with an integer displacement recording its winding class; `16/9 × 9/8 = 2` retains the factor that completes the octave. A lattice vector is not a frequency ratio, and the winding class does not recover every event of a journey. Their authorial coordination carries return-with-difference without asserting a formal equivalence between the objects. A physical confinement claim still returns to its apparatus and measurements.

paragraph.text: Here “raises their standing” concerns an additional historical or empirical claim, not a ladder on which operational homology must climb to become legitimate. [C30 — Psychoid Number](../../concepts/C30-Psychoid-Number.md) **defines** an Offered inquiry into the efficacy of number across psychic and physical descriptions. Its formal identities remain exact; its historically situated Jung–Pauli questions remain source-specific; its computational extension must show what changes in an apparatus. Evidence for one office cannot silently settle another. The inquiry's value lies in the discriminating work it makes possible.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Homology and Analogy field]] therefore bears a positive comparison discipline. Identify the operation in each domain, the transformation that relates them, what that transformation preserves and what it leaves out. Historical descent needs historical evidence; a mathematical equivalence needs its hypotheses; empirical efficacy needs observation. The authorial operational homology is register3 and is not weakened by remaining an operational homology.

paragraph.text: [C61 — Disclosure Architecture](../../concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **extends** this return into the relation among Matheme, Mytheme and Episteme. A formal expression, a whole story and a historically warranted account each disclose through a determinate aperture. Their relation is bidirectional: an imaginal source can give rise to a formal expression, and a formal articulation can alter how the image is encountered. The source/appearance relation is recursively situated. A real local Bimba can condition a subsequent disclosure while itself remaining dependent upon a wider source; recursion neither cancels its local source office nor promotes its record into ultimate ground.

[Homologia / Analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **grounds** the reciprocal comparison that this architecture must let a reader perform. An imaginal source can generate a formal expression; that expression can disclose another aspect of the image and change its interpretation. The route keeps the transformation and each register's warrant available in both directions. A real local Bimba conditions the next determination while itself remaining source-dependent in a further Bimba–Pratibimba relation. An attractor's organisation of trajectories and an atlas's relation among situated views keep their different operations within this recursion.

paragraph.text: The cross-register transmission **returns-to** [Movement 34 — lacan matheme mytheme](../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/34-s4-p3-lacan-matheme-mytheme.md) through the two directions between imaginal source and formal expression. Lacan's cut keeps its historical account, QL its own source-relation and recognitive return; a shared stroke or incomplete formalisation does not make them one doctrine. The whole lived image remains capable of changing the returned reading.

[Homologia / Analogia](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) **qualifies** the transmission by retaining the different work of each mark and image. Lacan's cut and barred subject remain attached to their source-specific account; the [native QL sequence carries its own positive source-relation and recognitive return](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source). A shared stroke or incomplete formalisation does not establish doctrinal identity. Mytheme can supply the imaginal source of a Matheme, and the resulting formal expression can return to change the image's reading. This reciprocal movement preserves the whole lived carrier instead of treating it as an example exhausted by its notation.

paragraph.text: E6 follows what contraction makes available. A permission, a period of time and a selected field of relevance distribute different capacities; increasing one does not automatically enlarge the others. [A14](../../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **extends** this relation into computational process. A system's formal ability, permission to execute and capacity to answer for an effect need distinct accounts. The source of each allotment becomes consequential when an obstacle requires the terms of action to change. [C26](../../concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md) **qualifies** the inverse: an apportioned office can treat its received share as ownership of the economy which sustains it.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] grounds the resource consequence at operational-homology register 3. Finite power, time, attention, labour and energy are distributed before a process acts. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] extends that distribution into the obligation to return evidence, consequence and value. The developmental token-economy question supplies one specific Open test: how a metered language run's demand for completion affects whether it preserves an unresolved remainder or forces a false closure. Executed succession does not, by itself, prove an identity between mathematical counting and physical time.

paragraph.text: [A15](../../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **grounds** the exactness of the comparison. Its terms must be distinguished and brought under a stated unit before their ratio becomes usable. A denomination joins a named token to an amount recognised in circulation. Its efficacy depends on an issuer, a bearer and practices which let its claim be honoured. Name and number meet here by public operation; the separate lexical histories remain in the [naming branch](HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md#e6-names), which **qualifies** their historical relation.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account]] defines the return from a countable distinction to an addressable participant and a contestable account. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] grounds the distribution through which the criterion gains its office. Their whole-field operations remain distinct from word histories. In particular, *nomen* and *numerus* do not share a historical line merely because a denomination brings name and number together.

A15 follows the next movement: the criterion by which something counts must itself become reckonable. Otherwise a result can remain arithmetically correct while concealing the office from which it judges.

## Claim
The neutral baseline in alignment is already occupied by [datasets, comparison sets, reference policies, evaluators, institutions, and gauges](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#criterion-through-distinction).

[E2’s con text through diaphaneity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) carries preference’s concealed conditions back to the criterion that selected and evaluated the answer. Increased observability can expose those conditions while leaving the evaluator protected. Regard becomes consequential when what is disclosed can revise the criterion and its commission; a finite hidden condition is not thereby identified with metaphysical Zero.
**Mathematical anchor:** preference values identifiable through comparative relations and reference frames. **Political image:** the hidden zero as invisible governor. [[Mono-Poly: Whole and Many]] asks how dependencies remain shared without a metric claiming the whole; [[Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit]] asks whether the relation to those dependencies has become honest enough for trust to be risked. A plural alternative is modelled in [[41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields|§5 · #4 — Bimba and Energy-Based Fields]].

paragraph.text: [A25](../../arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the entrusted office, and [A28](../../arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **defines** the distinction between intention, formulated commission and situated agency. The delegate meets circumstances which the commission has not exhausted. Its fidelity includes the capacity to bring back an obstacle, objection or changed possibility. [A29](../../arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** this into the distribution of product and cost: the commissioner, performer, beneficiary and bearer of consequence can be different participants. [C53](../../concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** the relation their separate accounts must retain.

The delegated-office operation **returns-to** [the whole Ares–Aphrodite relation](../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release). An undertaking apportions a possible loss to Poseidon and enables Hephaestus to release the lovers; the song leaves payment unreported. [A25](../../arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) receives the responsible office, while [A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) receives committed reliance beyond the completed display. This is an evidence-register-3 relation, preserving the different claims of marriage gifts, fine and contingent surety rather than deriving one legal history from their narrative succession.

The [Apportionment / Economy whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **extends** this relation into the distribution of labour. An office acquires effective power through work done elsewhere: people carry out decisions, sustain infrastructure and encounter consequences that the deciding position does not experience directly. If only the completed product returns, the office can appear self-sufficient while its dependence grows. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** that dependency; [A29](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** the obligation it places on the commissioning position.

## Claim
The neutral baseline in alignment is already occupied by [datasets, comparison sets, reference policies, evaluators, institutions, and gauges](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#criterion-through-distinction).

[E2’s con text through diaphaneity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) carries preference’s concealed conditions back to the criterion that selected and evaluated the answer. Increased observability can expose those conditions while leaving the evaluator protected. Regard becomes consequential when what is disclosed can revise the criterion and its commission; a finite hidden condition is not thereby identified with metaphysical Zero.
**Mathematical anchor:** preference values identifiable through comparative relations and reference frames. **Political image:** the hidden zero as invisible governor. [[Mono-Poly: Whole and Many]] asks how dependencies remain shared without a metric claiming the whole; [[Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit]] asks whether the relation to those dependencies has become honest enough for trust to be risked. A plural alternative is modelled in [[41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields|§5 · #4 — Bimba and Energy-Based Fields]].

paragraph.text: [C54](../../concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) **defines** governed plurality. Participants require authority over their interiors and ways to share without losing the ability to revise, refuse, leave and reconnect. [A30](../../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** that distribution into reciprocal world-constitution: another's contribution can change the local conditions from which action proceeds. A shared store becomes consequential through permissions and correction routes; possession of the store alone does not provide them.

Governance enters because contributions change powers. A source correction with no route into the receiving decision is inert; a powerful receiver that absorbs others' work while denying their capacity to contest its use has converted co-internality into capture. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment whole field]] derives the relation of a contributed share to its sustaining economy. Local authority, privacy and refusal remain necessary to a field that cannot be owned by one participant.

scope_witnesses.text: The developmental [[compassion-as-sensitivity-to-origins|Compassion carrier]] differentiates three offices. Eros supplies the motive: the articulated field desires to know its sources and limits. Compassion gives that return its non-devouring orientation: the Other is met without being exhausted as a resource for the account. paragraph.text: [C62](../../concepts/C62-Planetary-Computation.md) **extends** the account beyond the visible session. Hardware has material conditions; deployment assigns permissions; standards determine circulation; subsequent uses distribute benefit and burden. The analysis must follow each consequential relation far enough to identify who can change it. An energy total cannot alone settle labour attribution, and a provenance record cannot alone grant those affected the power to contest use.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture|Cultural Individuation]] returns the infrastructure to the culture whose measures it exteriorises. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins|Compassion]] gives the return its sensitivity to origins and affected lives. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] supplies register-3 attention to who receives capacity, who bears cost and which office can alter that distribution.

paragraph.text: E6 follows what contraction makes available. A permission, a period of time and a selected field of relevance distribute different capacities; increasing one does not automatically enlarge the others. [A14](../../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **extends** this relation into computational process. A system's formal ability, permission to execute and capacity to answer for an effect need distinct accounts. The source of each allotment becomes consequential when an obstacle requires the terms of action to change. [C26](../../concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md) **qualifies** the inverse: an apportioned office can treat its received share as ownership of the economy which sustains it.

Register **3**. Return C26 → C49/A12 → C54/A29 → C26.
